requisitionListUid.description: Requisition list UID. Required for edit/rename modes.

onSuccess.description: Callback on successful operation. Receives created/updated list.

onError.description: Callback on error. Receives error message.

RequisitionListForm.description: Form for creating, editing, or renaming requisition lists.

routeRequisitionListDetails.description: Function to generate URL for requisition list details. Receives list UID.

RequisitionListGrid.description: Grid view of all requisition lists with create, rename, and delete actions.

routeRequisitionListGrid.description: Function to generate URL for navigating back to grid view.

onUpdate.description: Callback when list is updated. Receives updated list data.

RequisitionListHeader.description: Header for requisition list detail view with back navigation and list actions.

canCreate.description: Enables creation of new requisition lists when true.

sku.description: Product SKU to add to list.

selectedOptions.description: Array of selected option UIDs for configurable products.

beforeAddProdToReqList.description: Callback before adding product. Use for validation (for example checking required options). Throw error to prevent modal opening.

RequisitionListSelector.description: Dropdown selector for adding products to requisition lists with create option.

requisitionListUid.description: UID of requisition list to display (base64-encoded).

skipProductLoading.description: Skips automatic product loading when true. Used in tests.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page for pagination.

selectedItems.description: Set of selected item IDs for bulk operations.

routeRequisitionListGrid.description: Function to generate URL for navigating back to grid view.

RequisitionListView.description: Detail view of a requisition list showing items with pagination and bulk actions.
